messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortemwe turned a few notes into concrete alert-tuning tasks. Need owners + short ETAs. Proposed list:
• redis-error dedupe + fingerprinting (owner: lee)
• model-inference-latency threshold sweep + canary (owner: nina)
• paging policy split infra/app + examples (owner: maria)
• recurring-incident pattern analysis (owner: oliver)
Please ack and give ETA. I will create the GH issues and link here.

oliver: Ack. I'll take recurring-incident analysis. ETA: next Wed. Will look for common tags / services and whether deploys correlate. Need export of incidents for last 90d.

nina: Ack for inference thresholds. ETA: baseline job + PR by Tue. Will propose p50/p95/p99 cutoffs and a canary rollout plan. @maria can you share traffic split to pick canary cohort?

lee: Ack for redis dedupe. ETA: PR w/ matcher + tests by Fri. Question: do we prefer suppression windows or dedupe-with-fingerprint? I lean fingerprint + TTL so we still record event counts.

oncall-bot: Created recurring meeting 'incident-pattern-review' Mondays 09:00 UTC. Invite: #eng-oncall.

maria: For canary, start with non-production model hosts (2% traffic) then 10% for 24h if metrics look good. I'll add that to the canary checklist. Traffic split: non-prod vs prod tag available.

oliver: For incident export, use: https://redwood/incidents/export?range=90d . I'll pull service, deploy-tag, alert-type, duration columns.

nina: Quick numbers from the inference dashboard (last 14d): p50=35ms, p95=160ms, p99=420ms. Will use these as baseline before changing thresholds. Dashboard: https://redwood/dashboards/inference-latency

lee: For dedupe: plan is to compute signature = hash(alert.name + instance + short-stack) and dedupe window=3m for cache errors, 1m for ephemeral network blips. Example matcher snippet:
```
match: alert.name == "redis-error" && message =~ /OOM/
action: fingerprint + ttl=180s
```
I'll include opt-out param for critical incidents.

maria: Good nuance on ttl per type. Oliver, please flag any recurring incidents that look like "noise" vs legitimate churn so we can adjust windows per class.

oliver: Will categorize into: deploy-related, capacity-related, infra-transient, flapping. Expected counts and top services by Fri.

nina: On thresholds: I'll run a baseline job that simulates alerting at current thresholds and compute false-positive rate. Posting baseline CSV Wed. Canary rollout plan: 2% -> 10% -> 100% with automated rollback if error-rate or user-impact metric degrades by >5% within 1h.

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/472 - dedupe matcher + unit tests. r? @maria @nina

maria: Thanks. I'll create GH issues for each action and assign. Recording deadlines here: lee (dedupe PR opened, finish reviews by Fri), nina (baseline+PR Tue), oliver (incident patterns Wed), maria (paging policy doc Mon). weekly review meeting in calendar.

lee: One more ask  can we add a short telemetry flag to alerts to show whether a dedupe suppressed them? Want to preserve metrics for counting.

nina: Agreed. Also add a metric for "alerts triggered vs pages sent" so we can tune paging policies without losing visibility.

maria: Will add both to the follow-up tickets. Closing loop: owners/ETAs set. If anyone hits a blocker, ping here and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:
